# Matrix

Every product, client, and project, with its docs, repo, environments, and leads.  The Name column is the canonical project tag used on every other tab.  Blank cells are unknown, never guessed.

Type: Product, Client, or Project.  Parent: the product or client a project belongs to.  My involvement: Active, Paused, or blank.

| Name | Type | Parent | My involvement | Description | PRD | TDD | Repo | Staging URL | Production URL | AIA | Tech Lead | Updated |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| — | No rows yet | — | — | — | — | — | — | — | — | — | — | — |

# Items

The floating list: tasks, commitments, milestones, and open questions.  One row per item.  Types: Task, Commitment, Milestone, Question.  Statuses: Open, In progress, Waiting, Blocked, Done, Dropped.  Done and Dropped rows move to the Archive section below.

## Active

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

# Decisions

Dated decisions with the rationale given.  A reversed decision is never deleted: its status becomes "Superseded by D-n" and the new decision gets its own row.

# People

Everyone you hold 1:1s with.  Each person gets a sub-tab under this one with their next 1:1 agenda and a dated notes log.  Commitments made in a 1:1 live on Items (Type: Commitment) and are referenced by ID from the person's tab.

| Person | Relationship | Cadence | Next 1:1 | Open agenda items |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| — | No people yet | — | — | — |

# Inbox

Updates that could not be filed with confidence, in the user's words, dated, with the question that would settle them.  Cleared during review.

- Empty

# Log

Append-only history, newest first.  One line per change: date, IDs touched, what changed, and the user's words when they explain why.

- {{TODAY}}: Tracker created.

# Guide

How this tracker is kept.  The central-tracker skill reads this tab first on every run.

## Next IDs

T-1 · M-1 · C-1 · Q-1 · D-1 · R-1 · X-1

T = task, M = milestone, C = commitment, Q = question, D = decision, R = risk, X = dependency.  IDs are never reused.

## Project tags

The Name column on the Matrix tab is the canonical list of project tags.  A new product, client, or project gets a Matrix row, not a line here.

## My allocation

Not set.

## Time zone

Not set.  Until it is, dates and times follow the session's local time.

## Where things go

| Kind of update | Tab |
|---|---|
| Task, commitment, milestone, open question | Items |
| A choice made, with or without rationale | Decisions |
| Something that could go wrong | Risks and dependencies: Risks |
| X can't start or finish until Y | Risks and dependencies: Dependencies |
| 1:1 agenda item, 1:1 notes | People: that person's sub-tab |
| A product, client, or project's description, PRD, TDD, repo, URLs, AIA, or tech lead | Matrix |
| Anything ambiguous | Inbox |
| Every change | Log |

## Last review

Never
